CLI for the Wiki Memory Engine

Usage: wm-cli [COMMAND]

Commands:
  init            
  mcp             
  setup           
  agents          
  search          
  index           
  page            
  graph           
  health          
  source          
  task            
  log             
  lint            
  validate        
  time            
  model           
  decide          
  status          
  config          
  version         
  migrate-memory  
  help            Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
